title: Ardency
summary: 'ARDENCY, noun [Latin ardens, from ardeo, to burn.] Warmth of passion or affection; ardor; eagerness; as, the ardency of love or zeal.

inlines.v: 'ARDENCY, noun [Latin ardens, from ardeo, to burn.] Warmth of passion or affection; ardor; eagerness; as, the ardency of love or zeal.
